name: AgentMemory Skills
tagline: Recall, remember, hand off, and learn from project context
description: Installs 17 AgentMemory skills for saving and recalling knowledge, session handoffs, lessons, history, and configuration guidance. The bundle is pinned to the 0.9.31 source release.

install.notes: Memory workflows use the AgentMemory MCP server. Install the companion MCP entry and start `npx -y @agentmemory/agentmemory@0.9.31` separately for the complete tool set. These instruction files do not install automatic capture hooks; prompts and tool activity are captured only when a supported hook integration is installed separately.
